verdict.rationale: Decagon's docs mention integrations that let agents 'retrieve data' with no custom code (decagon-docs-33, decagon-docs-19/26), and separate products that analyze past customer tickets (decagon-docs-6) and detect gaps in the help center (decagon-docs-10/18), implying some multi-source knowledge grounding. However there is no explicit statement that Decagon directly ingests internal wikis, docs, or help-center content as unified knowledge sources without manual re-authoring, nor any independent/hands-on confirmation of this ingestion pipeline. Missing for 10: explicit doc/wiki ingestion mechanics, confirmation of 'no re-authoring' claim, and third-party validation of knowledge-source breadth.
